source: Transcribed from user message. Clarification text normalized for spelling; decision supplement records interpretations separately.

answers.question: Should the portal home show the applicant’s current case, unfinished draft and any pending appeal together?
answers.context: Show only that applicant’s permitted records; a pending appeal may relate to the same case.
answers.clarification: It can never be all at the same time; only one at a time.

answers.question: Should closed cases appear in a separate past-cases list?
answers.context: The list would show reference/status and permitted messages, appeals and released certificates, not unlock original closed questionnaire/evidence.

answers.question: Should each case have an applicant-facing timeline of key events?
answers.context: For example submitted, returned, accepted, assigned, hearing update, decision, appeal and closure. Exclude internal notes, votes and deliberations.

answers.question: Should the home page prioritize actions the applicant needs to take?
answers.context: For example complete a draft, address returned items, respond to an invitation or read a new request.

answers.question: Should an applicant see a clear “case is closed” explanation before the appeal option?
answers.context: Explain that an appeal is a new-information submission, not ordinary editing of the original case.
answers.clarification: Case is closed; appeal is available based on new information/evidence.

answers.question: Should a draft show a section checklist of missing required answers and documents?
answers.context: The USD 250 fee remains disclosed before starting and payment stays at the completed-application end.

answers.question: Should the applicant see a full review of their answers and attachments before signing and paying?
answers.context: This reviews only their own submission; neither spouse’s answers overwrite the other’s.

answers.question: Should returned applications open directly to the reviewer’s correction instructions and relevant form areas?
answers.context: Keep original answers/history; do not add another filing fee or require a new signature for corrections.

answers.question: Should an applicant’s post-submission correction to one field become an explicit Save action for that field or section?
answers.context: Use Other to prefer automatic saving. No reason or re-signing is required, and every committed change is retained.

answers.question: Should draft-expiry warnings also appear inside the portal?
answers.context: The existing 180-day inactivity expiry and seven-day email warning remain; this asks only about an on-screen warning.

answers.question: Should a council request for information appear as a separate actionable item with an applicant response area?
answers.context: The current message history remains authoritative; this would link responses to the request without creating a private chat feature.

answers.question: Should the applicant be able to add documents directly when responding to a request while the case is open?
answers.context: Uploads stay inside the portal with existing ownership, limits and history; no email attachment submissions.

answers.question: Should council mark a request resolved after reviewing the response?
answers.context: If No, the exchange can remain ordinary recorded correspondence with no separate request status.
answers.clarification: Response of what? What type of response?

answers.question: Should applicants be able to send a new case message from the portal, in addition to replying to existing case emails?
answers.context: This would be recorded case correspondence, not live chat. The sender cannot contact the other applicant or expose their own private data to them.

answers.question: Should portal replies and email replies appear in one private conversation history for that applicant?
answers.context: Use Other if you want portal read-only correspondence and email-only replies. Staff sees the authorized case communication record.

answers.question: Should the document area group the applicant’s latest files by document category?
answers.context: Applicants still cannot browse older attachment versions or the other party’s files.
answers.clarification: Attachments must be attached and shown in the correct place; follow the previously agreed naming convention.

answers.question: Should a replacement upload clearly show which existing document it will replace?
answers.context: Preserve the original in council-only version history; ordinary replacement is available only in the permitted open proceeding.

answers.question: Should the portal show the applicant’s own payment/waiver status and receipt for each filing?
answers.context: Do not show the other party’s payments or internal waiver administration; no applicant waiver-request option.

answers.question: Should applicants be able to download their individual payment receipt?
answers.context: This is a receipt, not a case-record export. Use Other if the provider receipt alone is sufficient.

answers.question: Should upcoming testimony invitations appear in a dedicated appointments area?
answers.context: Date, time, instructions and Confirm/Reject are already agreed; no applicant rescheduling and no private council agenda access.

answers.question: Should the portal show a map/address or remote attendance link supplied by staff for testimony?
answers.context: Only for that applicant’s own appointment. CTM is not required to host video calls merely by storing a link.

answers.question: Should the applicant receive an automatic reminder one day before their testimony appointment?
answers.context: Use Other to specify a different interval, channels or no reminders. Initial/change invitations already use portal/email.

answers.question: Should notifications distinguish unread from read and allow the applicant to mark them read?
answers.context: This affects the applicant’s inbox state only, not proof of legal service or changes to case records.

answers.question: Should the appeal page display the applicant’s appeal statement, additions, fee status and council Accept/Decline result together?
answers.context: Only their own appeal information; the other applicant’s appeal evidence remains private.

answers.question: Should adding appeal information display a chronological list of the applicant’s prior supplements?
answers.context: These are retained additions, not edits to the originally submitted appeal statement.

answers.question: Should withdrawal require a short confirmation screen before taking effect?
answers.context: No approval or withdrawal reason is added. The screen explains the applicable case/appeal effect and nonrefundable fee.

answers.question: Should a decree notice show that the certificate is not yet available until staff releases it?
answers.context: No download link or certificate preview before explicit release; the detailed handover process remains a separate discussion.

answers.question: Should a released certificate display its decree ID, language and release date next to View / Download?
answers.context: Access remains exact-recipient/current-released-version only; earlier certificate versions stay hidden.

answers.question: Should applicants manage their notification language and verified email change inside an account settings page?
answers.context: English/Arabic preference and verified email changes are already approved; this asks where those actions live.

answers.question: Should updating account contact information leave submitted case answers unchanged until the applicant explicitly corrects the permitted case fields?
answers.context: Keep account data and signed submission assertions distinct; no retroactive rewrite of past applications.
